title: Listen and Choose a Response — Commuting

questions.stem: Why were you so late this morning?

options.A: I'll be on time tomorrow, I promise.
options.B: Yes, it was late in the morning.
options.C: The train stopped between stations for twenty minutes.
options.D: I usually leave home around seven.

questions.explanation: A why-question needs a reason, and a delayed train explains the lateness.
